fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M76RH0, no owner. The planner read the intent (owner chose option A on 2026-11-11: a pre-push self-check in every run), the push paths in code (shipPush in internal/api/ship_close.go used by ship open-pr and the land push; ship rebase's push in ship_rebase.go), ship.gate and rhiza.ship.localGate, ship.generate, and the plan, plan-milestone and ship-change workflows. It raised one batched question (which intent, where to enforce, the setting's name, where a plan's failure goes). The arbiter answered with Decision pre-push-check-shape: serve milestone-25 like ship-local-gate did; enforce in the shared push path, running rhiza check then the project's command, refusing the push on failure; setting rhiza.ship.prePushCheck, empty default, make self-check for this repo; localGate keeps its meaning; ship-change routes a failed pre-push check to gate-fix within its cap; plan and plan-milestone get a prepush-fix agent step (max_visits 2) back to open-pr. The planner then wrote five leaves under wait-green-pr.
fields.title: Plan of the pre-push check in every run (autonomous, arbiter)
